The new no-track path can discard an existing board continuation when ownership evidence is incomplete, unreadable, or inconsistent, and it also drops a required freshness check. These are correctness issues in the handoff mechanism.

Full review comments:

- [P1] Do not treat hash-shaped text as proof of track ownership — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\.claude\hooks\lib\session-report.js:146-146
  When a row contains a commit-looking token that is not returned by `myCommits` (for example, a trailerless sibling-repository commit), `boardTrack` returns null but `무주줄` excludes that row solely because it matches this regex. If it is the only such row, the handoff takes the `모호 === 0` path, says the board need not be reopened, and starts a new track even though the row may belong to the current session. A hash-shaped marker is not proof that the current session was ruled out; verify ownership or keep the row ambiguous.

- [P1] Require a readable board before creating a new track — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\.claude\hooks\lib\session-report.js:205-212
  When `무주줄` returns `null` because `docs/세션보드.md` cannot be read, this fallback still ends with an instruction to create a new track. A read failure does not establish that the current session has no board row, so a transient permission or filesystem error can cause a duplicate track and lose the existing continuation; reserve the automatic new-track instruction for a confirmed zero, and require the board to be read otherwise.

- [P2] Keep the latest-commit check in no-track handoffs — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\.claude\hooks\lib\session-report.js:210-212
  The previous no-track handoff ended with `git log --oneline -10`, but the new branch removes that freshness check. If another session commits after this handoff is generated, the next session can choose work from stale history and collide with it; the repository explicitly requires this check immediately before starting work (`CLAUDE.md:77`).

- [P2] Use one board snapshot for both no-track decisions — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\.claude\hooks\lib\session-report.js:162-162
  `buildHandoff` reads the board once through `boardTrack` and then reads it again through `무주줄`. With the documented concurrent sessions, another edit between those calls can make the track lookup and ambiguity count describe different versions, allowing the `모호 === 0` branch to claim that no own row exists; read and parse one snapshot for both decisions (`CLAUDE.md:72`).

- [P2] Classify board rows without requiring an ISO date — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\.claude\hooks\lib\session-report.js:144-144
  `무주줄` only considers lines containing a `YYYY-MM-DD` token, while the existing board guard treats any non-header, non-separator table row as data (`.claude/hooks/board-guard.js:89-95`). A legacy or manually entered row with another date format or a blank date is therefore skipped; if it is the current unmarked row, the count can become zero and the handoff will incorrectly skip the safe board recheck.
